body:
I edited the URL with the correct label name. I'm not sure I understand what you mean @Haroenv with encoded URL.

Labels are not necessary but they would be useful for:

* Filtering questions coming from users not understanding our documentation (or users needing more information on a specific page)
* Stats to measure how relevant our documentation becomes over time (fewer issues tagged with this label, the better it gets)

If we go that path, we should consider creating a specific label for this kind of issues.
